name: l5_ground_load_ladder_v1
description: Supported-chassis L5 instrumented ground-load ladder. Move only L5 hip/knee through four increasing press plateaus (20/32, 22/36, 24/40, 26/44 deg), then retract and settle at zero. Intended to establish repeatable current/load/lag versus commanded foot depth before loaded cyclic flex tests. Soft torque 420; trip after three consecutive readings above 0.75 A; immediate ceiling 3.0 A.
